method_notes: Merton community schools: distance measured in a straight line by Merton Admissions' computerised Geographical Information System, from a start point plotted within the applicant's home property to the main school reception entrance; ties broken by random allocation. Dundonald, Wimbledon Chase and Wimbledon Park give priority to children inside an Admissions Priority Area before distance. Academies, free school and VA faith schools are their own admission authorities with their own criteria (Source: Merton community school admission arrangements 2026-27, s.4.5.5; Reception 2025 booklet).

gaps: Merton only publishes cut-offs for its 27 community schools; the 16 own-admission-authority schools (11 VA/ex-VA faith, 4 academies, 1 free school) show 'Please contact school for further information' in all years, so no distances recorded for them and their measuring method was not verified. Each year has three distance columns (16 April offer day, second round, 1 September); 'value' is the 16 April offer-day figure, with second-round and 1 Sept figures in criterion_note. Text was extracted via an AI-summarised PDF fetch: Dundonald and Wimbledon Chase 2026 rows had ambiguous column alignment (noted), and Garfield 2025 / West Wimbledon 2024 rows had only two values for three columns. PAN recorded is the 2026 'No. Places' (some differ in earlier years, e.g. Haslemere/Hatfeild/Malmesbury/The Sherwood 60 in 2024, Poplar 90 in 2024-25). School type from the 2025 booklet; possible later academy conversions other than St John Fisher not checked. Postcodes from the 2025 booklet (St John Fisher from a GIAS-derived site); GIAS not checked directly.
